functions.name: Get ( ScriptParameter )

functions.name: Get ( ScriptResult )
functions.serverMeaning: Returns the last completed subscript result. A PSOS caller requires Wait for completion to obtain the result reliably.
commonErrorsOrCaveats: Do not confuse script result text with transport/runtime success.

functions.name: Get ( LastError )
functions.serverMeaning: Numeric error from the most recently executed script step.
commonErrorsOrCaveats: Read immediately after the step under test.
If, Else, Else If, End If, Loop, Exit Loop If, End Loop, Exit Script, and Halt Script do not clear the previous error.
Pair with Get ( LastExternalErrorDetail ) for ODBC/cURL/external failures.

functions.name: Get ( LastExternalErrorDetail )
functions.serverMeaning: 19.5-safe name for detailed ODBC/external errors.
